say:1:1322544001:1.text: I can't believe I'm saved! I thought I was a goner...
say:1:1322544001:1.source_cn: 真难以相信，我居然得救了！我还以为自己这辈子就要到头了……

say:2:1322544002:1.text: Who knew the undead could be this aggressive?!
say:2:1322544002:1.source_cn: 谁也没想到这些活死人居然这么有攻击性！

say:3:1322544003:1.text: Magister, please! My friend's on the island in the lake! You have to save him!
say:3:1322544003:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，求求你救救我的另一位同伴，他往湖中的岛上去了！
say:3:1322544003:1.male: Magister, please! My friend's on the island in the lake! You have to save him!
say:3:1322544003:1.female: Magister, please! My friend's on the island in the lake! You have to save him!
